purpose: Apple Music and Apple Music Classical service-client candidate for makOS Music.
evidence_type: Read-only upstream source inspection. No installed runtime, account sign-in, protected-stream playback, or Linux compositor test.

sources.evidence: CastLabs Electron v45.2.1+wvcus, @holusion/dbus-next, Linux AppImage/deb/rpm/flatpak/snap targets, BlueOak-1.0.0.

Persistent isolated sidra session; components.whenReady waits for Widevine; sandboxed Electron window with nodeIntegration false and contextIsolation true; allowed-navigation filtering; Linux MPRIS adapter; Apple Music web navigation.
Media metadata, playback state and capability properties; Player and TrackList D-Bus interfaces; org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.<app name> bus ownership.
Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0. Any redistributed portions must include license text or license link.

useful_for: Apple Music service rendering and authentication through Apple's web interface
MPRIS integration with makOS Control Center Now Playing and media controls
Separate installed application with Wayland/X11 support and Linux package formats
assessment.ui_fidelity: Apple Music web UI. Does not reproduce the native macOS Tahoe Music application, toolbar, menus, local library, or animations by itself.
assessment.compatibility: Electron service client, not a drop-in Qt/QML music backend. Keep separate from the current QtWebEngine profile and local-file player.
assessment.audio: README advertises lossless on macOS and Windows; Linux lossless has not been established by this audit.
assessment.global_menu: Current makOS global menus use a private Cutefish protocol. Sidra's Electron window requires separate menu/decorations integration and validation.
assessment.local_library: Retain local playback separately; deepin-music remains a local-library candidate.

proposed_integration: Build/package the pinned source as a distinct Linux application in an isolated environment.
Verify Wayland window identity, decorations, activation, minimize/restore and fullscreen under the actual makOS compositor.
Connect the shell's media view to the MPRIS interface, including metadata and confirmed playback state; preserve capability flags.
Test account sign-in and protected playback with an explicitly provided test account/session, without reusing host browser credentials.
Retain upstream DRM sandbox and authentication protections, plus required license notice.
Only then select whether Music opens the Sidra service client or the local-library view; do not label untested playback or native Tahoe fidelity as complete.
